$comment: Agent profile (agentConfig): config/agents/*.json, Lab configurations and the start command. go/contract.ParseProfile is the one validator, used by the coordinator and the executor; it refuses unknown keys and checks the per-harness rules this subset cannot say. See contracts/README.md for the supported keyword subset.

effort.$comment: Codex only (required there); null or absent for the other harnesses.

instructionRole.$comment: codex: developer (or absent); claude: system; antigravity and acp: user.

mcpServers.$comment: Named grants: design-rules and Serena Go navigation; each at most once.

tools.$comment: Claude only, required there: native tool grants.

delegationProfiles.$comment: At most 8 profile ids this profile may delegate to.

gitNetwork.$comment: The agent may use the network for git.

id.$comment: design-rules or serena; no executable or environment values.

data.$comment: Opaque experiment data, at most 16384 bytes as compact JSON.
